critical_issues: Key‑reading implementation relies on low‑level terminal APIs (termios/tty on Unix, msvcrt on Windows); in non‑interactive environments it may raise errors or always return 'q'.

judge.summary: The provided main.py contains a complete, runnable implementation of the classic 2048 game on a 4x4 grid. All core mechanics—arrow‑key movement, merging, random tile spawning, move‑availability detection, score tracking, and highest‑tile display—are present and evidenced by concrete code. Minor platform‑specific concerns exist around key input handling and screen clearing, but they do not undermine the functional completeness or the likelihood that the script can be executed in a standard terminal. Verdict: pass.
